scope: Independent read-only equation fidelity, public guard contracts, local ZIP test CLI; no app/HDR engine integration or publication approval.

resolved_findings.issue: Equal invalid Primaries enumeration values could pass the first candidate validation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Known primaries whitelist now rejects invalid values; regression assertion independently executed.

equation_review.result: PASS: floor blue*63 only, 8x8 tile selection, fixed 512 coordinate offsets, background/skin mix by supplied mask alpha, final uniAlpha mix and preserved input alpha. No accidental adjacent-blue interpolation.
equation_review.domain: For accepted finite RGBA in [0,1], the shader input clamp is the identity. Out-of-domain values are rejected, not silently clipped. Caller supplies already spatially matched mask alpha after vertical-coordinate inversion.

equation_review.result: PASS: floor/ceil blue*63 lookup, fract interpolation, original fixed 512 coordinate offsets despite actual 1024 atlas, final uniAlpha mix and preserved input alpha.
PASS: normalized nearest or bilinear texel-center sampling with clamp-to-edge. Orientation and sampler are explicit caller contracts; original runtime values are not asserted.

guard_review.accepted: Matching explicit known primaries with either encoded sRGB or gamma 2.2, full range, finite unit RGBA/alpha/mask, supported explicit sampler and valid square 8x8 atlas geometry.
guard_review.rejected: Linear, HLG, PQ, unknown transfer/primaries/range/sampler, differing encodings, limited range, non-finite or out-of-range color/alpha/mask, invalid dimensions/count/shape and non-finite UV.
guard_review.note: Full-range BT.2020 primaries with an explicitly supplied supported SDR transfer are not treated as HDR merely because of the primaries. No transfer conversion is performed.

independent_execution.additional_guard_coverage: All 12 known primaries/SDR-transfer/sampler combinations; invalid enum values, authored limited range, input alpha and mask NaN/infinity/out-of-range, invalid UV/sampler, texel alpha, overflow/oversized dimensions and invalid atlas shapes.
independent_execution.zip_cli_positive: PASS with both caller-local ZIPs, pinned archive and asset hashes checked.
zip_cli_negative: Missing positional arguments rejected with exit 2.
Swapped archives rejected with exit 1 before temporary private fixture creation.
independent_execution.test_harness_note: Temporary independent guard harness compiled and ran locally, then was deleted; an initial harness-only misleading-indentation warning was corrected before its successful run.

private_asset_handling.zip_member_access: Named in-memory reads, no archive extraction by the test.
private_asset_handling.temporary_fixture_lifecycle: TemporaryDirectory owns decoded RGBA fixtures and removes them after probe execution, including failure cleanup.

limitations: This is pointwise algebra equivalence under the stated caller contract, not bit-identical GPU execution: GLSL lowp/highp quantization and original GPU sampling/decode were not measured.
Source PNG row orientation, original texture sampler and actual authored encoding remain caller-supplied assumptions, explicitly recorded by tests.
Tests do not prove these selected materials were active in a particular capture or that observed global intensity maps directly to uniAlpha.
No skin segmentation, face tracking, mesh deformation, native inference, full style reconstruction, HDR preservation, Android integration or on-device execution is established by this component.
